import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates(keep='first')
    
    # Fix island label variant
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip()
    
    # Convert body_mass_g to numeric and handle commas
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    
    # Remove out-of-range body_mass_g values
    df = df[(df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)]
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Group by sex and calculate average body mass
    result = df.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean().to_dict()
    
    # Remove missing group keys (if any)
    result = {k: v for k, v in result.items() if pd.notna(k)}
    
    return result
